items.description: This very AWESOME list is made to help anyone interested in extensively customizing their Linux desktop, or what we call 'ricing'. It's a very good place to start your adventure, helping you discover what you can use, or what ELSE you can use to over-customize your rice. The goal is to have some of the very popular themes and tools, as well as some lesser-known ones, to help you find that perfect fit. It's your go-to list when you need to waste your time ricing, instead of tending to your responsibilities.
